Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Identification number assigned to the vehicle by the fleet operator. This may not be a legal registration.

IdentificationNumber.name: Identification Number
IdentificationNumber.definition: Number that uniquely identifies the vehicle as assigned by the vehicle manufacturer.

UnitNumber.name: Unit Number
UnitNumber.definition: Identification of the unit number of the vehicle in the fleet.

TrailerNumber.name: Trailer Number
TrailerNumber.definition: Identification number assigned to the trailer.

TagEntryMode.name: Tag Entry Mode
TagEntryMode.definition: Entry mode of the registration tag.

Odometer.name: Odometer
Odometer.definition: Odometer reading value indicating the distance travelled by the vehicle (for example, car, van, pickup truck, semi-truck portion of a tractor trailer unit).

Hubometer.name: Hubometer
Hubometer.definition: Hubometer reading value indicating the distance travelled by the trailer (for example,  the semi-trailer portion of a tractor trailer unit).

MaintenanceIdentification.name: Maintenance Identification
MaintenanceIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to the vehicle related to maintenance.

OnBoardDiagnostics.name: On Board Diagnostics
OnBoardDiagnostics.definition: Data captured from on board diagnostic systems.

AdditionalData.name: Additional Data
AdditionalData.definition: Additional information related to the vehicle.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
